meals.name: Crispy quesabirria tacos with chile consommé for dipping
steps: Pat 2½ lb birria-seasoned beef dry and brown it in 1 Tbsp oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high, about 3 minutes per side.

Add 1 diced onion, 5 smashed garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano, 1 bay leaf, 1 Tbsp cider vinegar and 3 cups beef broth. Cover and simmer gently 2½–3 hours (or bake at 325°F) until fork-tender, well past 145°F.
Shred the beef. Skim the red fat off the broth into a bowl and season the broth (the consommé) with salt and a squeeze of lime.
Dip each tortilla in the fat, lay it on a hot skillet, top with cheese and beef, fold and crisp 2 minutes per side. Serve with cups of hot consommé, chopped onion, cilantro and lime wedges.

meals.name: Garlic-chili shrimp fried rice
steps: Cook 1⅓ cups rice the day before (or spread hot rice on a sheet pan and chill 30 minutes) — you want 4 cups cold rice.
Thaw and pat dry 1 lb peeled shrimp; toss with 1 tsp soy sauce and ½ tsp red pepper flakes. Sear in 1 Tbsp oil over high heat 1–2 minutes per side until pink and opaque (145°F). Remove.

Scramble 3 beaten eggs in 1 Tbsp butter, then push aside. Add 1 Tbsp oil, 5 minced garlic cloves and the white parts of the green onions; sizzle 30 seconds. Add the rice and peas and fry 4–5 minutes without stirring too often so it crisps.
Stir in 3 Tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp sesame oil, fold the shrimp back in and finish with sliced green onion tops and more chili flakes to taste.

meals.name: Cider-glazed pork chops with Honeycrisp apples and onions over buttered noodles
buy: 1 cup apple cider or apple juice
steps: Season 2 lb thin pork chops with 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp pepper and 1 tsp dried thyme. Sear in 1 Tbsp oil over medium-high 2–3 minutes per side until 145°F; set aside to rest.
Lower the heat, add 1 Tbsp butter, 1 sliced onion and 2 Honeycrisp apples cut in wedges; cook 6 minutes until golden. Add 2 minced garlic cloves for 30 seconds.
Stir in 1 cup cider, 1 Tbsp Dijon, 1 Tbsp brown sugar and 1 Tbsp cider vinegar; simmer 4–5 minutes until syrupy, then swirl in 1 Tbsp butter.
Meanwhile boil 8 oz egg noodles and toss with 1 Tbsp butter and a pinch of salt. Return the chops to the pan to coat and serve over the noodles with the apples and glaze.

meals.name: Sheet-pan chicken shawarma bowls with garlic yogurt and tomato-cucumber salad
steps: Whisk 3 Tbsp olive oil, juice of ½ lemon, 3 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Toss 1½ lb chicken breast strips in it and marinate 20 minutes or up to overnight.
Spread on a sheet pan and roast at 450°F for 15–18 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the edges char a little. Meanwhile cook 1 cup rice.
Garlic yogurt: 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1 grated garlic clove, juice of ½ lemon and a pinch of salt. Salad: halve the grape tomatoes, dice the cucumber, toss with a pinch of salt and a drizzle of oil.
Build bowls of rice, chicken, salad and a big spoon of garlic yogurt; dust with more paprika.

meals.name: Blackened salmon with brown-butter roasted butternut squash
steps: Peel and cube a 2½ lb butternut squash; toss with 1 Tbsp olive oil, 1 Tbsp brown sugar, ½ tsp salt and a pinch of cayenne. Roast at 425°F for 25–30 minutes, flipping once.
Mix the blackening rub: 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder and thyme, ½ tsp oregano, ½ tsp cayenne, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Coat 1½ lb salmon (4 portions) on all sides.
Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high and cook the salmon 3–4 minutes per side until well crusted and 145°F inside.
Brown 2 Tbsp butter in the same pan until nutty, add a squeeze of lemon, and spoon it over the squash and salmon.

meals.name: Hot-honey buffalo drumsticks with crunchy celery slaw and potato wedges
steps: Toss 3 lb drumsticks with 1 Tbsp oil, 1 tsp each garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt and ½ tsp pepper. Cut 2 lb potatoes into wedges and toss with 1 Tbsp oil and salt. Roast both at 425°F for 40–45 minutes, turning once, until the chicken reaches 165°F (175°F is even more tender).
Melt 3 Tbsp butter with ½ cup hot sauce and 3 Tbsp honey; simmer 2 minutes.
Slaw: thinly slice 4 celery ribs and grate 1 carrot; toss with 2 Tbsp mayo, 1 Tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tsp honey, salt and pepper.
Toss the hot drumsticks in the buffalo-honey sauce and serve with the wedges and cold slaw.

meals.name: Butternut squash and ricotta stuffed shells (meatless)
steps: Roast 2 lb cubed butternut squash with 1 Tbsp olive oil and salt at 425°F for 25 minutes until soft; mash. Boil the jumbo shells 2 minutes less than the package says and drain.
Mix the squash with the ricotta, 1 egg, ½ cup Parmesan, 1 cup of the shredded mozzarella, 2 minced garlic cloves, ¼ tsp nutmeg, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper.
Simmer a 28 oz can of crushed tomatoes with 1 Tbsp olive oil, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp Italian seasoning and a pinch of chili flakes for 10 minutes. Spread half in a 9×13 dish.

Fill the shells, nestle them in, spoon over the rest of the sauce and top with remaining mozzarella. Cover and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes, uncover for 10 more; drizzle with 2 Tbsp browned butter before serving.

meals.name: Thai-style garlic-chili ground chicken with basil over rice
steps: Cook 1½ cups rice. Stir together 3 Tbsp soy sauce, 1 Tbsp brown sugar, 1 Tbsp lime juice and 2 Tbsp water.
Heat 2 Tbsp oil over high heat; add 6 minced garlic cloves and 1 tsp red pepper flakes for 20 seconds, then 1½ lb ground chicken. Break it up and cook 6–7 minutes until browned and 165°F.
Add the sliced bell pepper for 2 minutes, pour in the sauce and toss until glossy.
Off the heat, fold in a big handful of basil leaves until wilted. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Smothered pork chops in onion gravy with garlic roasted broccoli
steps: Season 2 lb center-cut pork chops with 1 tsp each smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt and ½ tsp pepper; dredge in ¼ cup flour. Brown in 2 Tbsp oil over medium-high, 3 minutes per side, and set aside.
Melt 2 Tbsp butter in the pan, cook 1 large sliced onion 8 minutes until golden, stir in 2 Tbsp flour and 1 tsp thyme, then whisk in 2 cups broth and 1 tsp soy sauce.
Return the chops, cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until 145°F and the gravy is thick. Meanwhile cook 1 cup rice.
Toss 1½ lb broccoli florets with 1 Tbsp oil, 2 minced garlic cloves and salt; roast at 425°F for 15 minutes. Serve chops and gravy over rice with the broccoli.

meals.name: Garlic-mustard London broil with smoky roasted sweet potatoes
steps: Marinate 2 lb London broil 4 hours or overnight in ¼ cup soy sauce, 2 Tbsp vinegar, 2 Tbsp olive oil, 1 Tbsp Dijon, 1 Tbsp brown sugar, 4 minced garlic cloves and 1 tsp Italian seasoning.
Cube 3 lb sweet potatoes, toss with 2 Tbsp oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt, and roast at 425°F for 30 minutes.
Broil the steak 4 inches from the heat 6–8 minutes per side to 145°F (medium); rest 5 minutes.
Melt 3 Tbsp butter with 1 grated garlic clove and a pinch of Italian seasoning. Slice the steak thin across the grain and spoon the garlic butter over the steak and potatoes.

meals.name: Lobster ravioli in garlicky tomato-cream sauce
steps: Bring a big pot of salted water to a boil for both 13 oz packs of ravioli.
In a wide skillet melt 2 Tbsp butter, add 3 sliced garlic cloves and ¼ tsp red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute. Add 1 jar of the marinara and simmer 5 minutes; stir in ½ cup cream.
Cook the ravioli per the package (about 4 minutes), then lift them straight into the sauce with a splash of pasta water.
Toss gently, season with pepper and serve with ¼ cup grated Parmesan on top.
